title: Microsoft's IPO Turns 40: A Journey from $1,000 to $5.5 Million! — 2026-03-14
description: Join us as we celebrate Microsoft's 40th IPO anniversary and explore how a $1,000 investment in 1986 could be worth $5.5 million today. We'll also discuss OpenAI's ambitious plans to reach a $1 trillion IPO valuation by matching Microsoft's size, and the latest in tech investments, including Nvidia's $2 billion stake in Nebius Group. Plus, learn about the ex-Anthropic researchers raising capital for a new startup and Eightco's funding boost.
